seq=[3,4,5,6,7,8,9,1,2]
out=[]
for r,row in enumerate(grid):
    rr=[]
    for c,v in enumerate(row):
        if v==0:
            val=seq[(c-1)%9] if r==c else seq[c%9]
        else: val=v
        rr.append(val)
    out.append(rr)
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in out))
